description: This file defines the ILEDControl interface for controlling and querying LED states in a device, including supported states, current state, and setting new states.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ILEDControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling device LED states, including retrieving supported states, current state, and setting a new state.

methods.name: GetSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Returns the list of supported LED states at runtime.

methods.name: SetLEDState
methods.description: Sets the device LED to a specified state.
